SECRET
PF.45807/B.4b.
25th November 1939.

Dear Colonel Vivian,

With reference to PF.45807/B.4b. of 28.10.39., herewith attached for your information a copy of the translation of an intercepted letter from Karl GIMBELL to OTTEN.

Yours sincerely,

F.C.D.

Lt.-Colonel V. Vivian, C.B.E.
S.I.S.
